summary: Frontend-only verification of Admin-configurable Office Timing card at /admin/attendance + employee attendance view. All 6 scripted scenarios passed: initial render + testids present, Save-disabled gating, successful update with success toast + rules-strip refresh, persistence across reload, validation (end < start+7h) with correct toast, validation (auto-close <= end) with correct toast, employee header + rules strip reflect dynamic office hours. Regression smoke tests (Salary Sheet tab, Yearly Summary tab, Employees page) all render. Timing restored to 10:00/17:00/18:00 at the end as required.

ui_bugs.issue: Rule item 'Forgot to check out? Session auto-closes at 6:00 PM' hard-codes 6:00 PM instead of using d?.office?.auto_close. When admin configured auto-close to 06:30 PM, the header + top strip updated correctly but this bullet still showed '6:00 PM', creating an inconsistency visible to employees.
Message 'session auto-closed at 6:00 PM' also hard-codes 6:00 PM; should use d?.office?.auto_close for consistency with dynamic timing.
